dem_flow_accumulation — DEM hydrology op

• Data kinds: depth → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.dem_flow_accumulation(dem, cell_size, fill=True, epsilon=1e-06, nodata='error') (to call the implementation directly, import demops; demops.dem_flow_accumulation(dem, cell_size, fill=True, epsilon=1e-06, nodata='error'); from the registry, opsdem.get("dem_flow_accumulation"))

Usage

Number of contributing cells: the count of upstream cells flowing into each cell (the cell itself counts as 1).

With fill=True sinks are filled first (otherwise flow stops in sinks, and downstream accumulation comes out silently too small). Accumulation of missing cells is nan.

Graph construction is vectorised. However, the effect is small: at 1024x1024, 2.71 s -> 2.39 s. What dominates is not the construction but the subsequent topological sweep (a Python loop over all cells). To make it faster, that part would have to be rewritten —— stated explicitly so as not to leave a "thought it was fixed but it wasn't".
